# Homepage browser performance closure

Current application: parent local `1042f0a30c9d254a11d2cde26ac32b476ab02d5f`.
Historical application: `498e253f76c7e23fbdb7077a313664dc88f240d5`.

`08af4bb1e408889a2ff330f87bf74d80a92f6b3631bd3c3bbaa8fee4027f6333`.
No app implementation was changed during this investigation; retained source
changes are the finite experiment and browser-test harness only.

## Inventory and comparability

The inventory was declared before measurement. Each source at each viewport
(1440×900 and 390×844) had four unprofiled cold loads, six scenario changes and
six inspector presses per load; one separately instrumented vitals session with
six changes/six presses; and two heap sessions with one warmup cycle followed
by six measured three-scenario cycles. This is 28 processes, 288 changes and
120 inspector presses. All 28 sessions completed successfully. Dismissals are
separate control inputs. Six changes plus six presses plus six Escapes are 18
discrete inputs per latency/vitals session.

Historical and current both implement this exact homepage consumer: same three
recorded briefs/compositions/features/accepted-neighbor defaults, seed 42,
36 search trials, six meander bounds, actual POST build API, dedicated browser
search worker, and the same running/complete/kept DOM contract. No fixture was
replaced with a synthetic benchmark. Schema identities, package APIs/algorithms,
formatting and chunking differ as the treatment; numerical equality of chosen
arrangements is not claimed. The scenario/search source diffs are included.
Both builds used their own frozen dependencies; relevant installed versions
match (see dependency-versions.txt), and no workspace source was cross-linked.

The same current test harness drove both deploy bundles through Miniflare/workerd
at the same origin/path. Each sample started a fresh Chromium and workerd, in
serial H–C–C–H blocks with same-source controls. Chromium was pinned by the
Playwright lockfile to 151.0.7922.34 (executable SHA256 in chromium-sha256.txt),
Bun 1.3.9. No CPU/network throttling, other test/build jobs, screenshots, heap
collection or in-page probe bundle ran in the unprofiled latency samples.
Browser and Worker launch are outside the page interval; OS caches are not
purged and the harness preflights assets. Narrow Chromium uses a desktop pointer,
not a real phone. The one agent-browser qualification visit was untimed.

Every scenario consumed HTTP 200 and verified the chosen brief, all five fixture
discs exactly once and with no transform, 36 trials, kept paper, no departing
discs and nonempty prose. Inspectors opened while searches were still running.
All browser error arrays are empty. Heap cleanup followed the actual docs link
and verified the stage unmounted; all eight sessions released their worker.
